head_note: lane S4 (2026-10-07): four new IDENTICAL structural switches, all default off, plus the board harness's separate upload clock (tools/classical_two_datasets.py, not a control). Nothing compiled, run or queued by the lane.

sgd_epoch_contiguous.note: Minibatch SGD (batch 4096, the board's SGDRegressor/SGDClassifier route _sgd_mb_grid -> fused rows/steprows + parts kernels): once per epoch and problem, right after sgd_perm_kernel and inside the witness unit, two gather launches write the permuted copies xp[p] = x[idx[p]], ysp, swp and an identity order; the batch kernels then read contiguous rows (batch*d words, L2-resident) instead of scattered 44-byte rows. Cost: two streaming passes over X per epoch against batches x scattered-row latency. No bits move: every batch position sees the same operands (x row idx[p], ys[idx[p]], sw[idx[p]]) at the same position and the mb_dot/mb_part folds index by batch position, so the host twin (sgd_mb_one) is unchanged. Memory gate: free device memory >= 2x the copies (ctx.get_memory_info), else the incumbent gathered loads. IDENTICAL only; the FAST+Apple MOJOLEARN_SGD_FAST_EPOCH_RESIDENT arm is untouched and exclusive by mode. tools/bench_board_algos.py:222 mismatch note corrected (ours is minibatch 4096, not per-sample).

linear_gram_solve.note: LinearRegression (alpha 0) and Ridge (alpha > 0) as ONE resident centered-Gram fit: X and y up once; exact column sums + binary64 means (col_sums_pair_buf/col_means_buf); the centered Gram and cross X^T y read straight from resident X by the blocked leaf kernels (bm_centered_gram_panels, new bm_centered_cross_panels; binary-counter fold; leaves contract_leaf_size(n)); power-of-two equilibration (ols_equilibration_scale); the IDENTICAL Cholesky cells (chol_diag/chol_col_elem statements, one launch per column); a trust gate (non-positive pivot or pivot^2 < 2^-12 of its equilibrated diagonal, x_linear RIDGE_FF_GATE); parallel per-column triangular solves; no U formed. Status 1 (not trusted) -> the Python glue runs the incumbent route (OLS: centered TSQR + SVD cutoff; Ridge: 4-crossing glue + Jacobi eig), both columns alike. Bits change (normal equations); the host column glm/host/gram_solve_host.mojo runs the same cells (centered_gram_v1_cell, new centered_cross_v1_cell, chol_serial, same solve statements). Quality check owed on istella (ill-conditioned; the gate is expected to fall back there for OLS). Reach: classical:ols (LinearRegression.fit, before the TSQR branch, unweighted) and more:ridge (Ridge.fit, before the centering glue). Under 'on' the OLS controls ols_one_entry/C24_TSQR and the Ridge control c02_linear_pair act only on the fallback path. Default ON in IDENTICAL; `_OFF` is the incumbent (TSQR OLS / SVD Ridge) arm. Grid run ge123e6f9 (NVIDIA L40S + AMD MI325X, full board data, one scored run per arm); PROMOTED to the IDENTICAL default by lane/grid-flips-1 2026-10-08 (Andrew 13:00Z); numbers at the declaration and in docs/apple-fast/EXPERIMENTS.md.

rsvd_tsqr_ortho.note: PROMOTED 2026-10-10 (lane/grid-act-6, grid g50ebe26a5, one run per arm): the TSQR orth is the IDENTICAL default; _OFF restores the two-pass route; the old on-define is refused. randomized-svd combined 0.710x istella (NV 0.824 / AMD 0.611), 0.638x taxi (NV 0.757 / AMD 0.538). Bits change vs the old default on the host column and both GPU vendors together. randomized_svd's nine orthonormalizations (Kit.orth -> x_decomp_dev_orth -> orth_on_device: two sliced Householder qr_factor passes + 1-thread guard + per-row trsm, ~154 launches/6 syncs each) become ONE blocked TSQR pass (ts_factor_device, the OLS kernels) plus the explicit Q from the kept reflectors applied to the rank-guarded selection C = diag(R[j,j] != 0) (ts_apply_device_buf, C built on the device), ~25 launches/1 sync per orth. Cost: the m x l sketch is read three times at full width instead of being walked by 2,048 strided threads; latency-bound, so it holds for any tall sketch with l small. Bits change (one TSQR Householder pass instead of two sliced passes); the host column HostExec.orth takes the same route via ts_factor_host/ts_apply_host. A dependent column maps to an exactly zero Q column (randomized_svd's nlive compaction contract kept). Shapes outside the TSQR's (l > 512, m < l, Int32 overflow) keep the two-pass route on both columns; TS_SMEM_OK gates the device as for OLS. orth_diag (linalg.svd's U) and the FAST-only SVD_FAST_CHOLQR/DECOMP_FAST_ORTH_WS paths are untouched. more:tsvd does not share this route (covariance_eigh).

idn_kmeans_centroid_fold.note: The Lloyd update's fold_block_table_kernel (one thread per (cluster, feature) cell walking EVERY 256-row block serially: k*d threads on one SM, twice per iteration, fabric-crossing on multi-die parts) becomes a two-level parallel fold: level 1 a grid of (32-cell tile x group) blocks whose 32x8 threads sum a fixed strided subset of the row blocks (coalesced over the 32 cells) and fold the 8 lane partials in shared memory in a fixed halving order into one partial per (group, cell) in the table's scratch tail; level 2 one thread per cell over the groups ascending. Groups = min(n_blocks, 64): 512 chains per cell tile cover memory latency on any GPU of this class and level 2 stays <= 64 loads. The table is never modified (the gated arms refold an untouched table past convergence). Int32 fixed-point addends with wrapping addition are associative and commutative (choose_scale bounds any subset in Int32), so every grouping yields the same words: NO bits move and the host twin (host_accumulate, 8192-row chunks) is unchanged. Reaches all six fold sites: the blocked and gated launchers (classical:kmeans Lloyd loop, both conv arms) and the C37 fused path; tables sized by blocked_acc_table_cells/kmeans_fused_table_cells now include the scratch tail. Apple (KMEANS_BLOCK_ACC off) reaches it only under C37. Default ON in IDENTICAL; `_OFF` is the serial per-cell chain. Grid run ge123e6f9 (NVIDIA L40S + AMD MI325X, full board data, one scored run per arm); PROMOTED to the IDENTICAL default by lane/grid-flips-1 2026-10-08 (Andrew 13:00Z); numbers at the declaration and in docs/apple-fast/EXPERIMENTS.md.

expanded:sgd-reg.route: fit: SGDRegressor.fit -> _sgd_fit -> x_linear_fit -> fit_device -> _sgd_mb_grid (batch 4096: sgd_perm_kernel [+ sgd_gather_x/vec kernels under sgd_epoch_contiguous] -> SGD_IDN_MB_FUSE rows/steprows + parts kernels per batch -> sgd_mb_end_kernel)

expanded:sgd-clf.route: fit: SGDClassifier.fit -> _sgd_fit -> x_linear_fit -> fit_device -> _sgd_mb_grid (same minibatch route as sgd-reg; binary hinge)

classical:ols.route: fit: LinearRegression.fit -> [linear_gram_solve: linear_gram_fit (status 0 ends the fit)] -> else _ols_tsqr_centered -> x_decomp_ols_tsqr_r (C24_TSQR) -> _tsqr_lstsq_core
classical:ols.note: with linear_gram_solve on and the Gram trusted, C24_TSQR is inert (fallback path only); the crossing records that

more:ridge.route: fit: Ridge.fit -> [linear_gram_solve: linear_gram_fit (status 0 ends the fit)] -> else _column_means/_classical_xy_means (c02_linear_pair) + _center + ridge_fit (ridge_eig_traced)
more:ridge.note: with linear_gram_solve on and the Gram trusted, c02_linear_pair is inert (the centering glue is bypassed)

expanded:randomized-svd.route: _randomized_decompose -> _rsvd_core (Kit.mm -> launch_gemm; Kit.orth -> x_decomp_dev_orth -> orth_on_device [rsvd_tsqr_ortho: _orth_tsqr_device (ts_factor_device [C24_TSQR] + ts_apply_device_buf) | two-pass qr_factor + guard + trsm]; Kit.svd)
expanded:randomized-svd.note: C24_TSQR's panel/rows/tree knobs tune the TSQR that rsvd_tsqr_ortho routes orth through, so the pair is crossed; off, C24 reaches rSVD only through qr_sliced's C24_TREE4

classical:kmeans.route: fit: cluster.estimator kmeans_fit -> Lloyd loop -> min_cluster_and_distance_compute[_gated] + launch_accumulate_*_blocked[_gated] -> launch_block_table_fold [idn_kmeans_centroid_fold: centroid_fold_part/final kernels | fold_block_table_kernel] -> finalize_centroids_kernel
classical:kmeans.note: the fold runs inside the blocked path (the C37 fused path was deleted 2026-10-08, grid ge123e6f9)

more:gmm.route: fit: mixture/estimator.mojo init_params=kmeans -> cluster.estimator.kmeans_fit (same Lloyd loop and fold as classical:kmeans)

more:ivf.route: build: ivf_flat_build coarse kmeans -> kmeans_fit_main_traced (same Lloyd loop and fold)

notes: Item 5 (not a control): tools/classical_two_datasets.py records `upload_separate` per scored round for ours (a second H2D upload of the same input via x_cnn_res_upload, timed after every clock of the round closed) and `upload_ms_separate` / `fit_minus_upload_ms` (derived) on CTD-SPAN; the scored clock boundary is unchanged.
